programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: Key & Peele
programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan har en flickerkamp og en MMA-fighter går for vidt, når han disser modstanderen. Andre sketches inkluderer en bryllupsgæst, der vil være dj og spille 'klassiske' numre.

programme.title: Key & Peele: MC Mom

programme.title: Key & Peele: The End

programme.desc: Jordan og Keegan fejrer Halloween ved at flygte fra racistiske zombier, skuespillerne i 'Human Centipede' har en skræmmende genforening, og vi besøger en folkeskole for troldmænd med problemer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sexy Vampires
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer en uhyggelig asiatisk spøgelsesbofælle, fyrene ser på den lyse side af tortur og Keegan oplever et hus fyldt med sexede vampyrer.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Slap-Ass

programme.title: Key & Peele: East West Bowl #2

programme.title: Key & Peele: Hollywood Sequel Doctor

programme.title: Key & Peele: Black Ice News
programme.desc: Sketches inkluderer Samuel og Lashawn, der glæder sig over fordelene ved deres nu lovlige ægteskab, en politibetjent, der møder sin nye makker og Lando fra 'Star Wars' bliver forfulgt af en superfan.

programme.title: Broad City: Rat Pack

programme.title: Broad City: 2016
programme.desc: Ilana finder sit nye kald, og Abbi tage forbi det mest frygtede sted i verden: motorkontoret.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed

programme.desc: Da Abbi indser, at hun er for sød, bliver hun straks mere bitchy. Ilana beslutter sig for at nå sit fulde potentiale. De går til en eksklusiv fest og møder nogle dejlige dj's. Nu kan intet gå galt.

programme.title: Broad City: Hurricane Wanda

programme.title: Broad City: In Heat

programme.title: Broad City: Mochalatta Chills
programme.desc: Der dukker nye muligheder op, når Abbi endelig kan træne nogen på Soulstice og Ilana får succes som firmachef.

programme.title: Broad City: Wisdom Teeth
programme.desc: Abbi skal have sine visdomstænder trukket ud og Ilana ser det som sin pligt at passe hende til hun får det bedre - hvilket selvfølgelig indebærer en masse 'medikamenter' og et totalt mangel på tilsyn.

programme.title: Broad City: Knockoffs

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night

programme.title: Forensic Files: Textbook Murder
programme.desc: Avis Banks and her unborn child were brutally murdered. The body was discovered by her fiancé, Keyon Pittman. When police learned that Pittman was having affairs with other women, he became the prime suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Two in a Million
programme.desc: A lifelong resident of the tiny town of Lefroy, Tasmania was murdered outside his own home. Robbery appeared to be the motive, but with no suspects, the investigation came to a halt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crime Seen
programme.desc: Edward Honaker was convicted of rape, sodomy and aggravated sexual battery and sentenced to three life terms in prison. He maintained his innocence. After years in prison and writing countless letters, he finally found someone who believed him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Legionnaires' Disease
programme.desc: After a Philadelphia Convention, 180 Legionnaires contract pneumonia-like symptoms and 29 of them die. The determination of one scientist helps identify the cause of this deadly disease.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money

programme.title: Forensic Files: Bio-Attack

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Search For Lisa Rene

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing

programme.title: The FBI Files

programme.title: South Park: Universets største nar
programme.desc: Da et berømt spititistik medium ikke kan mane Kenny ud af Cartmans krop, forsøger Chefs mor lidt voodoomagi på ham selv.

programme.title: South Park: Helvede på jord 2006
programme.desc: Det er halloween og Satan arrangerer verdens største kostymebal.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Dumb Starbucks
programme.desc: Nathan bruger parodijura for at hjælpe en café, der har det svært.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Electronics Store
programme.desc: Nathan kæmper mod et stort selskab for at hjælpe en elektronikforretning.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Horseback Riding / Man Zone
programme.desc: Nathan udtænker en måde, som en ranch kan betjene overvægtige ryttere på, en dameforretning prøver at behage mandlige kunder, og Nathan opdager, at han måske har begået en hadforbrydelse.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Sporting Goods Store / Antique Shop
programme.desc: Nathan prøver at få en sponsoraftale til en sportsbutik, og en antikforretning lærer, hvordan de kan udnytte deres 'Hvis du smadrer den, køber du den'-politik.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Movement
programme.desc: Nathan forsøger at få nogle løsarbejdere til at arbejde gratis for et flyttefirma.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Smokers Allowed
programme.desc: Nathan hjælper en bar med at omgå rygeforbuddet.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Travel Agent / Hotel
programme.desc: Et hotel prøver at appellere til seksuelt aktive forældre, et rejsebureau finder ud af, hvordan man scorer kassen fra de ældre kunder, og Nathan fortæller, hvorfor han aldrig kommer for sent.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Nail Salon / Fun
programme.desc: En plan om at forhindre neglelak fra at sprække, og Nathan konfronterer sin største personlighedsbrist.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Hero
programme.desc: Nathan forsøger at bevise, at der gemmer sig en helt i os alle.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Nathan For You: A Celebration
programme.desc: I dette særafsnit taler Nathan med tidligere gæster i serien, som f.eks. Brian Wolfe og spøgelsesmægleren.

programme.title: Dressed To Kill
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes sets out to discover why a trio of murderous villains, including a dangerously attractive female, are desperate to obtain three unassuming and inexpensive little music boxes.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes And The Secret Weapon
programme.desc: Starting in Switzerland, Sherlock Holmes rescues the inventor of a bomb-sight which the allies want to keep from the Nazis. Back in London it seems that the inventor is not all that he seemed.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes Faces Death
programme.desc: During WWII, several murders occur at a convalescent home where Dr. Watson has volunteered his services. Holmes is summoned to solve the crime from a long list of suspects including the owners, staff, and the patients.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes Terror By Night
programme.desc: Holmes is hired by Roland Carstairs to prevent the theft of the Star of Rhodesia, an enormous diamond owned by Carstairs' mother, Lady Margaret. Believing the diamond will be stolen on a train trip from London to Edinburgh.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 1
programme.desc: I første afsnit tager Evans og LeBlanc på en noget våd tur til Blackpool i et par åbne, tre-hjulede Reliant-biler.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 2
programme.desc: Jeremy, Richard og James forsøger at redde verden ved at bygge deres egen elektriske bil.

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 3
programme.desc: Holdet takler et af verdens største spørgsmål: Kan man bygge en amfibiebil, der er lige så god til vands som på land?

programme.title: Top Gear: Afsnit 1
programme.desc: Jeremy bygger en bil, der er endnu mindre en den berømte Peel P50, og så sælger han konceptet til de frygtede "drager".

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Sam frygter for sin families sikkerhed, da hans kone skal genoptage en sag, der involverer den berygtede Sidorov og hans stjålne atomvåben.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Da et mordvåben i Idaho matcher en sag i Los Angeles, tager Callen og Sam til Idaho for at slutte sig til "NCIS: Red", et team, som rejser rundt og opklarer forbrydelser.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: NCIS-teamet i Los Angeles fortsætter med at arbejde med rejseholdet, så de kan finde terroristen, inden han forsvinder.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Efter en flådeløjtnant og en pilot forgiftes med cyanid, efterforsker NCIS-teamet sagen for at afgøre, om giften var målrettet mod de to, eller om de var ofre for en test inden et større giftangreb.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Kensi og Deeks tager til Mexico for at undersøge en sag om en kartelboss' forsvundne lig. Resten af NCIS-teamet leder efter en potentiel lækage i DEA's specialenhed.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: A winding system of caves makes Kentucky one of the most unique geological wonders in the world. Near the caves is Bethlehem Academy, a long-abandoned Catholic School that is being kept alive by a unique resident.

programme.title: Pluto TV Hus fra helvede Promo
programme.desc: Kom indenfor, hvis du tør. Om dagen besøger vi ekstreme samlere og spøgelsesjagere, mens vi om aften skruer op for uhyggen med gyserfilm og træder indenfor i de mest rædselsvækkende, hjemsøgte huse. Filmene starter hver dag kl. 22.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Brødrene Gecko er mordere på flugt fra Texas. På vej mod Mexico, tager de familien Fuller som gidsler. Kaos opstår, da de søger tilflugt i en afsidesliggende stripklub, der viser sig at være fuld af vampyrer. Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: The Bat
programme.desc: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money. The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.

programme.desc: Caught in the act, a disguised bank robber hurled explosives at police and disappeared in a hail of bullets. When police identified the suspect, they connected him to an armed kidnapping, but they couldn't find him.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tools Of Death
programme.desc: Tool marking: A tool used to commit a crime can often be the same tool used to solve it. The pattern a machine leaves on an item, the unusual way a tool crimps a wire, and even something as innocuous as the shape of a wood chip can lead to a killer.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Out Of The Grave
programme.desc: New Forensic Techniques used to Solve Old Cases: Advancement in science and technology are encouraging people to revisit the past in hopes of answering questions that have remained unanswered, and solving crimes that seemed unsolvable.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: From The Ashes
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Jeweler's Wife
programme.desc: The wife of a successful jeweler is found dead in their home. The jeweler immediately falls under suspicion, but he's not alone.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Fat Bandit
programme.desc: A string of bank robberies in Winnipeg confound local police. Most bank-robbers are addicts, usually quite thin. This new man doesn't fit the profile: this bandit is fat.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Frenzy
programme.desc: Three bodies are found in a house, arms tied behind their backs. Stab wounds to the neck. Bloody footprints in the hall. A killing spree that leaves a woman, her boyfriend and a church deacon dead.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Pointing to Murder
programme.desc: A withered corpse is found half-buried in a field beside a theme park. Too decayed to identify properly, detectives have only the leathery fingers of one hand to work from.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Good Doctor
programme.desc: A single mother in Saskatchewan visits a hospital in the midst of a panic attack. Her doctor sedates her. Then, she is certain, he rapes her.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Sweet Killer
programme.desc: An aging hippy is going through bad times. When he's found dead in his home with a gut of antifreeze, it's a closed case. Then a shocking confession reveals a maelstrom of lies and a story of cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Stranger
programme.desc: Bored at home, a retiree takes a job at a 24-hour convenience store. On her third night at work a customer finds her behind the register in a pool of blood.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Hunted
programme.desc: A real estate broker doesn’t return home. Her family can't find her. But police do - dead in a closet in her office. The DNA on her body is tested against 150 men. No match. The case runs cold.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Predator
programme.desc: The phone rings in the middle of the night. On the other end of the line, the sounds of an attack. The couple that receive the call rush to its source and discover a horrific scene.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Evil Eyes
programme.desc: A dead woman is found in a park. It’s learned the deceased is a divorced landlady of a group home for transients. The suspect list is long; the clues to follow are few.

programme.title: On the Case: 22 Hours of Terror
programme.desc: A 12-year-old girl is kidnapped during a home invasion, and police frantically search for her and her abductor. Paula Zahn explores the case.

programme.title: On the Case: From Dusk to Darkness
programme.desc: After a 10-year-old girl mysteriously disappears, her family and the police undergo a tormenting journey to find a lead.

programme.title: On the Case: A Stranger Among Us
programme.desc: Sixteen-year-old Velda Rumfelt's disappearance in Brentwood, Missouri, in 1977 marked the beginning of a tragic, decades long mystery.

programme.title: On the Case: This is for Her
programme.desc: A deadly home invasion leaves a father of three dead. Why was the victim's wife, the only eyewitness to the crime left alive?

programme.title: On the Case: Shattered Hope

programme.desc: An investigation into the relationship between Dino Guglielmelli, a millionaire health supplement distributor, his model wife, Monica Olsen, his business partner Richard Fuhrmann, and the $80,000 "hit" Guglielmelli ordered on his wife.

programme.title: 48 Hours: A Raging Son

programme.title: Forensic Files: Chief Suspect
programme.desc: The wife of a respected police officer was murdered in her own home. The crime went unsolved for more than a decade, until a newly formed cold case unit took a fresh look at the evidence.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: Caught in the act, a disguised bank robber hurled explosives at police and disappeared in a hail of bullets. When police identified the suspect, they connected him to an armed kidnapping, but they couldn't find him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the southwest one serial bank robber claimed his loot went to the poor, but this thief was no folk hero. He had a gun and was willing to shoot.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Lethal Obsessions

programme.title: The New Detectives: Traces Of Guilt
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence: a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Electronic Witness

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Wrong
